subject: [PATCH v3 3/5] fs/proc/task_mmu: read the PMD once in smaps_pmd_entry()

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Identified the issue and suggested removing the extra folio_get() call to fix the reference leak.

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a folio reference leak during THP splitting in the mm/migrate_device code. The issue arises when migrate_vma_split_unmapped_folio() takes an extra folio reference, which is not dropped due to concurrent MADV_DONTNEED operations or PMD splitting. The patch removes this extra reference by using split_huge_pmd_address(false) instead of true.
